title: Sling chair in the travertine atrium

tokens.v: Set it inside the sun-patch so the hard edge of the light crosses the sling on a diagonal — half the saddle leather blown to warm amber with its grain raised, half sunk into travertine bounce, one brass pin firing a specular. Chalk dust drifts through the shaft above it. 24mm at f/8 from standing height, the walnut frame doubled in a wet-looking reflection down the polished screed. A travertine pier stands just off the lens, its vertical edge dark and soft, cropping the near-left and running out the top and bottom edges. Let the piece stand unmarked.
